_note: Simulated sellers. Not evidence about real sellers. L = opening (list) CPM, F = floor CPM the seller never goes below, k = how much of the gap to the buyer's offer the seller gives up each round.

personalities.title: Proportional conceder
personalities.plain: Opens high and gives up about a third of the gap every round.

personalities.title: Firm seller
personalities.plain: Opens near its floor and barely moves.

personalities.title: Takes any offer at its floor
personalities.plain: Holds its asking price but says yes to any offer of $26 or more.

personalities.title: Wall
personalities.plain: Will not go below $40. No buyer within budget can close.

personalities.title: Stubborn, then caves
personalities.plain: Refuses to move for three rounds, then concedes half the gap each round.

personalities.title: Random (seeded)
personalities.plain: Opening price $28-45, floor 60-90% of that, concession 0-50% a round. Same seed, same sellers.
